title: OFFER AND RING LINES IN CAPS
why: His order of 2026-10-09: raid text reads like a shooter HUD, a short caps callout, never a sentence. The review of the eighth batch of raid text found three lines still in the old voice. The offer line read Kite offers you Bandage, [T] to take it, 12s, and the giver saw Offered Bandage to Kite, Waiting, 12s; they now read KITE OFFERS BANDAGE, [T] TAKE, 12s and OFFER SENT, BANDAGE TO KITE, 12s. The count under EXTRACT A INBOUND read 3 converging on the ring and now reads 3 HOSTILES CLOSING IN, red past four as before (INBOUND stays his word for the craft). A teammate mark read KITE MARKER 120m; his word is Waypoint (his Marked Waypoint note), so it reads KITE WAYPOINT 120m. The keys, the seconds, the counting and where each line sits did not move.
now: The offer line, the hostile count on a called ring and a teammate mark read as caps callouts, such as KITE OFFERS BANDAGE and 3 HOSTILES CLOSING IN.
